label: Monthly revenue by subscription tier (last 12 months), with temporal JOIN on pricing history and marketplace attribution to user's active subscription at purchase time.

Complete invoice fetch (customer + line items + product details) via 4-table JOIN: invoices → users → invoice_lines → products. Random invoice sampled from pool of 1000 IDs per iteration to avoid buffer cache bias.
Active session + cart retrieval by user_id under 50 concurrent threads. One connection per thread (connection-pool model). Random user sampled from pool of 1000 IDs per iteration.

Top 10 co-purchase recommendations via 2-hop JOIN through order_items. Co-purchase count and confidence score computed per query — Neo4j will pre-compute these as ALSO_BOUGHT relationship properties. Random product sampled from pool of 1000 IDs per iteration.

Full-text product search using tsvector + plainto_tsquery with ts_rank_cd scoring. GIN index on search_vector column. Field weights: name(A) > description(B) > product_type(C). Random term chosen per iteration from pool of 25 domain-relevant queries.

All events for a user in a 30-day window, ordered by occurred_at DESC. Composite index on (user_id, occurred_at). Window centred on a sampled real event — guaranteed non-empty. Pool of 1000 (user_id, anchor) pairs.

7-day rolling average of daily revenue per subscription tier over a 183-day (~6-month) window with generate_series gap-filling. Subscription + marketplace revenue both included with temporal tier attribution (mirrors Q1 logic). Random window within actual invoice date range per iteration — no hardcoded dataset bounds.
